name: @openquok/browser-extension
description: OpenQuok browser extension for cookie-session social channels (Skool and similar)

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:icons && node ./scripts/build-extension.mjs && node ./scripts/copy-static.mjs && node ./scripts/verify-extension-dist.mjs
scripts.zip: pnpm --filter openquok-common build && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/zip.mjs
scripts.zip:firefox: pnpm --filter openquok-common build && pnpm run build:firefox && EXTENSION_OUT_DIR=dist-firefox node ./scripts/zip.mjs
